name: Aggie Ice Cream (USU Logan, UT) Famous "Aggie Blue Mint" (White Choc Chunks & Cookies)
brandOrRestaurant: Aggie Ice Cream (Utah State University, Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: USU's most famous and iconic flavor! Bright Aggie blue mint ice cream loaded with white chocolate chunks and chocolate cookie pieces. A Cache Valley pilgrimage dessert.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single scoop in a cup to savor during stable remission; take lactase enzymes if dairy sensitive.
watchOuts: High dairy cream and sugar content; enjoy in moderation
